properties.author: Apache Tomcat Project
properties.title: End of life for Apache Tomcat 8.5.x

section.name: End of life for Apache Tomcat 8.5.x
section.p: The Apache Tomcat team announces that support for Apache Tomcat 8.5.x will end on 31 March 2024.

ul.li: releases from the 8.5.x branch are highly unlikely
bugs affecting only the 8.5.x branch will not be addressed
security vulnerability reports will not be checked against the 8.5.x branch

section.p: Three months later (i.e. some time after 30 June 2024):

ul.li: the 8.5.x download pages will be removed
the latest 8.5.x release will be removed from the mirror system
the 8.5.x branch will be made read-only
the links to the 8.5.x documentation will be removed from tomcat.apache.org
The bugzilla project for 8.5.x will be made read-only

section.p: Note that all 8.5.x releases will always be available from the archive.
It is anticipated that the final 8.5.x release will be made shortly before 31 March 2024.
